value.rationale: The result corrects a structural construction stated immediately after the definition of Hom-associative trialgebras and replaces it with the exact universal classification. It distinguishes the unique nontrivial mixed associative direction from the tempting but false all-plus sum, using a counterexample already present in the source's foundational two-dimensional classification. Because scalar combinations of split operations are a standard way to pass between algebraic structures, the exact coefficient cone is a reusable structural fact rather than a routine isolated calculation.
